Test suite

Source: vignettes/tests.Rmd
tests.Rmd

The package ships with unit and functional tests in tests/testthat/. They build their inputs in-line or from the small fixtures in tests/fixtures/, so they need no network and no external data.

Running the tests 

library(testthat)
library(hydrofabric)
test_dir("tests/testthat")

Two end-to-end tests, a full aggregation of a fixture basin and a merge of per-VPU products, run only when NOT_CRAN=true is set; the aggregation test also needs mapshaper on PATH. Without them they are skipped, not passed.

Network topology

The acyclic and non-dendritic network tests are in test-core-utils.R: a cycle is detected, a non-dendritic (divergent) network is accepted as a valid graph, and a cyclic network is made acyclic. The same property is checked on every product by the invariant suite.

Checking a product with hfutils

A finished product can be checked with hfutils alone, without this package or its inputs. hf_check_invariants() runs the structural checks on one GeoPackage, and hf_check_merge_invariants() adds the conservation and completeness checks for a merged domain:

library(hfutils)

gpkg <- "prvi_ngen.gpkg"
fp   <- sf::read_sf(gpkg, "flowpaths")
dv   <- sf::read_sf(gpkg, "divides")
nx   <- sf::read_sf(gpkg, "nexus")

hf_network_is_dag(fp)                          # TRUE when the network is acyclic
hf_check_invariants("ngen", flowpaths = fp, divides = dv, nexus = nx,
                    strict = FALSE)
hf_check_merge_invariants(list(flowpaths = fp, divides = dv, nexus = nx),
                          gpkg = gpkg)

Each returns a list with ok and one entry per check. strict = TRUE stops at the first failure. hydrofabric::check_invariants() runs the full pipeline suite, which adds the checks that need the build’s intermediates.
